rationale: The stock broke down hard intraday (from an $11.32 open to a $9.86 low on 2.45x relative volume, notably weak on a day the broad market was up ~1%), but the last five 5-minute bars show it pinned at $10.37–10.39 on near-dead volume, sitting exactly at its 5-minute VWAP and 9-EMA — a balanced micro-state with no directional trigger in either direction. With a 19bps spread against a $0.02 five-minute ATR, an entry now pays full friction for a compressed-volatility consolidation; shorting a small-float biotech already 5% off its lows into the close carries squeeze risk, while longs have no reversal evidence and no visible news to anchor a thesis. Waiting for price to resolve out of this tight range offers better expected value than committing capital at equilibrium.
